subject: Temporary error messages during the computing process

messages.author: 7c95eca58f093ad2
messages.subject: Temporary error messages during the computing process
parts:
My shiny application has 2 main tabs and there are several sub tabs within each main tab.
The first main tab is mainly about importing data, processing data and then pass the updated data to the second main tab.
The second main tab will exploring the data on the new updated one.

It works without problems, except one small annoying thing.
There is a temporary messages appears on  second tabs, "Error: argument is of length zero".
This error is not a real error, because it appear only for a few seconds, then it disappears and the expected results come out.
I guess it's probably because it takes time to process the data in the first tab, before the first tab passes the updated data to the second one,  there is no input in the second tab, that's probably the reason of the error message?
After a few seconds and the second tab receives the updated data, the error message disappears.

Does anyone know how to hide this message and print the message something like "The data processing may take a few moments..."

I tried to use the function of withProgress, but it doesn't help, the error messages still appear, the waiting messages defined in withProgress function only shows after the error message disappears and starting to explore the updated data.

I don't know if my question is understandable, please feel free to let me know you doubts, I will try to explain.

Thanks in advance.

Jie

In any case the answer will be validate(), the only question is exactly where to put it and what value to pass in.
